Loaded Oreo Cream Cheese Brownies ~ An over-the-top decadent brownie recipe... Ultra fudgy, rich brownies are topped with a layer of cream cheese that's spiked with white chocolate chips before sprinkling on Oreos and chocolate chips. It's an easy, one-bowl, no-mixer brownie recipe that turn out fudgy with zero cakiness.
